messages:
morgan: quick question — we have a small docs-only change + a tiny serialization bugfix. do we publish as a patch (x.y.z) or bundle with the upcoming minor? thinking about downstream pinning and release-notes workload.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: release v1.9.3 -> canary @ 1918002100, rollout window 15m, status: queued. :robot_face:

javier: if the serialization bugfix affects API compatibility at all, patch. otherwise docs -> I'd leave for the next minor unless we need immediate consumer-facing fix.

sophie: what counts as API compatibility here? is it stable request/response schema or just a textual clarification?

morgan: serialization bug causes occasionally truncated metadata field in embeddings response when length > 8kb. causes some clients to throw. not theoretical.

emily: that's customer-impacting. patch. and we should include a short "migration" note in the release notes: how to handle truncated metadata if seen.

olivia: agree with patch. also vote to pin the runtime-dep in the release artifact for the patch release so we can rollback cleanly if we need to. pining means build artifact uses exact semver for that dep.

javier: +1 to pin in the patch. but we should be careful: pinning every dependency on every patch increases churn. maybe pin only the transitive dep that caused the break.

morgan: good point. this is coming from json-encoder 2.3.4 -> 2.4.0 in our lockfile. the fix is to revert to 2.3.4 for the patch. for minor we can re-evaluate and test at scale.

emily: release-note guidance: "v1.9.3 (patch) — Fix: embeddings metadata truncation (regression caused by json-encoder 2.4.0). Action: pinned json-encoder to 2.3.4. If you still see truncated metadata, file a support ticket with sample payloads." Keep it concise.

ops-oncall: rollback criteria reminder: for canary -> abort and rollback if error rate > 0.5% OR latency p95 increases > 30% sustained for 5m OR any customer-facing panics. For prod rollout stricter (0.2%).

sophie: should we change our tagging convention? we currently tag with annotated tags: `v1.9.3` and push `buildmeta` tags for CI. I'm proposing a small tweak: annotated tags for releases, and DO NOT include buildmeta in the tag name for patches (put buildmeta in CI artifacts only). keeps semver tidy.

javier: I like that. buildmeta in tags made backporting annoying. annotated `vX.Y.Z` + changelog entry + changelog link is enough.

morgan: consensus forming: publish v1.9.3 as patch, pin json-encoder to 2.3.4 in the release branch, use annotated `v1.9.3` tag, and keep buildmeta out of tag names for patches. add a short release note and a one-line customer-facing blurb.

deploy-bot: deploy started: v1.9.3 -> canary @ 1918002105. monitor channel: #eng-oncall.

olivia: quick checklist before prod rollout: 1) changelog entry ready 2) rollback playbook updated w/ dep pin revert snippet 3) qa smoke run on canary 4) telemetry alarms pre-wired.

emily: i'll draft the changelog entry and the one-line blurb. can someone add the dep-revert snippet to the rollback playbook?

javier: adding snippet now:```
# rollback snippet
# revert dep pin
git checkout -b rollback/v1.9.3-revert
# bump package.json back to caret for json-encoder
npm install json-encoder@^2.3.0 --save-exact
# rebuild and republish artifact
```

ops-oncall: monitoring: canary shows nominal errors so far (0.08%), p95 latency +2%. continuing.

morgan: thanks all. final question — semver policy doc update? we still have ambiguity for "dependency-only fixes that are not consumer-visible". propose adding a line: if any user-visible error/regression -> patch. docs-only or internal refactor -> minor if not urgent.

sophie: yes please update the semver doc. small bullet: for patches we should prefer stricter dep pinning and keep tags clean `vX.Y.Z`.

emily: I'll submit a quick PR to the release-policy doc after the release.

deploy-bot: canary complete: status OK. promoting to prod in 10m window per rollout policy.

ops-oncall: production rollout in progress. if anything abnormal -> `@ops-oncall` immediate page. :rotating_light:

morgan: closing thread — v1.9.3 patch approved. thanks everybody. :tada:
